notes.title: Patched for School and Mina Crashes
notes.notes:
Thanks to our amazing community, we were able to investigate and fix two random crashes. One when you visited the school a second time to look for items, and one in Mina's bad ending. They are now patched and everything should be working properly from now on!

Thank you again for your input and commitment, we couldn't do it without you!

P.S. We'll be having some nice discounts on our other VNs for Black Friday, so keep an eye out for that as well :D

x,
GG Team

notes.title: Achievements Fixed!
notes.notes:

Happy gaming!

notes.title: Translation Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We hope you're having a nice beginning of spring. It's snowing heavily here in Hope Hill Village and we cannot wait for this pesky fog to lift. 

As for the update, we proudly announce that Novena Diabolos is over 50% translated as of this week. We passed a very important checkpoint, and we are looking forward to an even bigger announcement soon. Stay tuned, and don't forget to share the game with your friends, foes, allies.

Cheers from the Novena Team!
